title: Captured Russian and Chinese weapons shown underground at Crane
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: they were telling us about the uh some Russian and Chinese weapon systems that were captured

plain: A man named Randy Anderson says that in 2014, underground at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy weapons research base in Indiana, he and others were told about Russian and Chinese weapon systems that had been captured. Anderson tells it as something he was present for, and if true it would mean the base held foreign hardware out of public view.
